question: Among our top 10 paying customers, can you identify the largest change in payment amounts from one month to the immediately following month? Specifically, please determine for which customer and during which month this maximum month-over-month difference occurred, and provide the difference rounded to two decimal places.
sql:
WITH top10 AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM (
        SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) as total_amount
        FROM payment
        GROUP BY customer_id
        ORDER BY total_amount DESC
        LIMIT 10
    )
),
monthly_payment AS (
    SELECT 
        p.customer_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', p.payment_date) as payment_month,
        SUM(p.amount) as monthly_amount
    FROM payment p
    INNER JOIN top10 t ON p.customer_id = t.customer_id
    GROUP BY p.customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', p.payment_date)
),
with_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        payment_month,
        monthly_amount,
        monthly_amount - LAG(monthly_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_month) as month_diff
    FROM monthly_payment
)
SELECT 
    c.customer_id,
    c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name as customer_name,
    d.payment_month,
    ROUND(d.month_diff, 2) as month_diff,
    d.monthly_amount as amount_this_month,
    LAG(d.monthly_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.payment_month) as amount_prev_month
FROM with_diff d
INNER JOIN customer c ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE d.month_diff IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY d.month_diff DESC
